India Batsman Devdutt Padikkal Scores Century in Tour Match

During a tour match against Sri Lanka Cricket XI in Colombo, Indian batsman Devdutt Padikkal scored an unbeaten 142. Veteran Ravindra Jadeja contributed 63 runs before retiring out. The Indian team finished their first innings at 357 for eight after 90 overs. This match is a warm-up for the upcoming Test series against Sri Lanka. Separately, reports indicate that batsman Sai Sudharsan has been ruled out of the Sri Lanka Test series due to an unspecified setback.
